reference: Olkiluoto, Finland, crystalline bedrock (no published log for these boxes)

description.lithology: Migmatitic gneiss / banded biotite gneiss. Medium to dark grey, medium-grained where discernible, with pervasive gneissic banding and foliation and abundant irregular white to pale-grey quartz-feldspar leucosome / segregations forming patches, lenses and discontinuous veins 1-5cm wide. Fabric is well foliated to banded, locally tightly folded / ptygmatic, especially in row 2 and row 3, consistent with migmatitic paragneiss.
description.alteration: none visible at this photo resolution - no distinct chloritic, sericitic, carbonate, potassic, silicified or oxidised staining is discernible; pale patches are interpreted as primary leucosome/veining, not alteration.
description.mineralization: none visible - no distinguishable pyrite, chalcopyrite, pyrrhotite, sphalerite or galena as disseminations, blebs, veinlets or massive accumulations at this resolution; estimated 0 vol% visible sulfides.

anomalies.explanation: Irregular light-coloured quartz-feldspar leucosome/vein network throughout all rows from ~23.66m to 26.7m forms prominent bleached-looking patches that should be checked on core to confirm they are primary leucosome/veins and not silicification.
Discrete open fractures/broken pieces are visible e.g. near the red mark in the top row and oblique break in the left third of row 3 - flagged for geotechnical check only, no count or RQD estimated.
